articles.title: How to follow Singapore Grand Prix on the BBC
articles.description: All the key BBC coverage details for the Singapore Grand Prix, the sixth and final sprint event of the season, which takes place from 9-11 October.

articles.title: Verstappen wins sprint after Russell crashes out
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen wins an incident-packed sprint race at the Singapore Grand Prix after George Russell crashes out of the lead.

articles.title: Verstappen on sprint pole after another settings issue
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen beats Mercedes driver George Russell to sprint pole at the Singapore Grand Prix.

articles.title: Mercedes critics think I'm Satan - Wolff
articles.description: Mercedes Formula 1 boss Toto Wolff rejects accusations of team of bias against George Russell, calling critics "brainless".

articles.title: Russell fastest from Leclerc in Singapore practice
articles.description: Mercedes driver George Russell leads Ferrari's Charles Leclerc in practice at the Singapore Grand Prix.
